description: This file defines the CleanUpInstallAPI class which extends an abstract REST controller to implement cleanup operations after an installation process in the OrangeHRM system. It handles POST requests to either drop the database or clean up after a failure based on the database type.

classes.name: CleanUpInstallAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class responsible for cleaning up installation, either by dropping the database or cleaning up after a failed installation, based on the current database type.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to perform cleanup operations; drops the database if a new installation, or performs failure cleanup otherwise.
